title: Stable Milos opening and avatar tap
details: Removed the synthetic pointer-to-click shim that could turn one Android tap into two menu toggles
Legacy onboarding repair now runs before Milos creates its menu state, so existing users are not blocked by a stale onboarding flag
The avatar now uses the normal single click route only
Update installation now waits for the new service worker to take control before reopening Milos
Version-check requests bypass the offline shell so controlled installed apps can actually move to the next release
